description.en: An Elasmosaurus platyurus reconstruction with an exceptionally long neck and short broad trunk. The skull completion and four paddles are comparative inferences from related elasmosaurids, not preserved parts of the anchor specimen.
description.zh: Elasmosaurus platyurus的完整复原，具有极长颈与短宽躯干。头骨补全和四鳍肢参照近缘薄板龙类推定，并非主锚标本的实存部分。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Elasmosaurus platyurus anchored to ANSP10081, retaining extremely elongated neck and short broad trunk. Four paddles and skull completion explicitly inferred from related elasmosaurids; never reduce whole animal to skull or claim a complete fossil exists.

scientific_limits.en: ANSP10081 preserves jaw fragments, almost complete cervical series, incomplete trunk/tail and rib fragments; girdles were documented historically but are now lost; limbs not preserved.72cervicals follows Sachs et al2013 revised count, not an uncritical2005table count. Real fragment photographs and measurements are evidence, not a whole skeleton photograph.10.5m total and7.0m neck are nominal reconstructed scale choices, not direct complete-specimen measurements. Neck scale constrained by centimetre centrum measurements and approximately7m historical estimate reviewed in2013; joint spacing is uncertain. Missing posterior skull, torso width and four paddles use comparative Thalassomedon anatomy, not claimed Elasmosaurus fossil surfaces. Its restored1940mount and modern replica are explicitly distinguished. Soft tissue/color inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: ANSP10081保存颌骨碎片、近完整颈椎序列、不完整躯干尾椎和肋骨；带骨历史有记录但已遗失，四肢未保存。72颈椎依2013修订，不照抄2005表中的旧计数。实物照片与量表非完整骨架照。总长10.5米及颈7米为名义复原尺度而非完整标本实测，颈部依据厘米级椎体量表及2013回顾的约7米旧估计约束，椎间距未知。后颅、躯干宽度和四肢比较补配自同科Thalassomedon，不冒充本属实物；其1940修复展架和现代翻模明确区分。软组织、配色推定。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: extremely elongated neck attached to a short broad trunk.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：连接短宽躯干的极长颈部。

evidence_anchors.neck: Sachs2005Table2 centimetre measurements ANSP10081, with preserved anterior centra~3.7–6cm and middle~10–12cm; actually viewed. Sachs,Kear,Everhart2013 revised72cervicals and real3cm-scale neck vertebrae Fig1/2 viewed. Primary gate is directly supported by target, not borrowed from comparator.
evidence_anchors.head: Sachs2005Fig1 real premaxillae/dentaries photographed dorsal/ventral,5cm scale viewed. Broadening posteriorly with six premaxillary teeth per side described; complete rear skull not preserved and must be inferred conservatively.
evidence_anchors.body_limbs: Sachs et al2021Fig1 Thalassomedon haningtoni DMNS1588 restored original mountA and replicaB plus UNSM50132C actually viewed. Same-family comparative ribcage/paddle basis only, not this species or exact proportional template. Do not copy whole Thalassomedon neck ratio.
evidence_anchors.scale: Original target vertebral measurements provide real size anchor. Nominal neck7.0m aligns historical7m estimate reviewed by2013 paper; nominal total10.5m=sum inferred0.45head+7neck+2.05trunk+1tail. No claim total10.5m is published measurement.

scale.scale_specimen: ANSP10081 vertebral centimetre measurements; incomplete specimen
scale.interpretation: Nominal axial scale, all flesh boundaries/component subdivision inferred, no direct total length measurement. Neck dominates~67%total and exceeds trunk by~3.4times. Preserve broad substantial body without inflating absent evidence.

morphology: Tiny narrow anterior head widening toward rear, modest mouth opening8degrees with slender recurved teeth. No enormous pliosaur skull. Six premaxillary tooth positions per side supported by actual fragments; complete visible tooth count simplified, not complete fossil formula.

Exceptionally long tapering neck dominates silhouette, roughly two-thirds total length, far longer than broad trunk. Smooth continuous flesh, no exposed vertebral beads. Near-horizontal gentle curve, not swan S or raised periscope.
Neck gently thickens toward shoulder, with body transitioning into a short broad deep rounded ribcage. Fleshed cross-sections inferred and must not make entire animal a thin noodle.
Four substantial tapered hydrofoil paddles surround trunk, comparable front/hind sizes, narrow rounded distal ends. Same-family inference explicitly; no land fingers/claws or giant flat wings.
Short tapering tail follows pelvis with conservative skin silhouette. No enormous tail copied from Cope wrong-end reconstruction, no fish crescent or dorsal fin.
Muted slate/olive back and paler underside inferred. Complete organism, no fossil slab or display rods.

shape_gate.required_combination: Extremely elongated neck with tiny head attached to a short broad trunk framed by four paddles. Original full body unchanged.
shape_gate.comparisons: Plesiosaurus prepared comparator neck~46%total, Cryptoclidus~36% and Dolichorhynchops~19%. Here neck~67% and short broad torso must read at equal length, not merely global enlargement. Thalassomedon is missing-part comparator only; do not copy its entire silhouette.
acceptance: Front lateral shows neck over3timestrunk and tiny head, never a scaled Plesiosaurus clone.
Top shows neck taper plus short broad oval torso and distinct four paddles.
Side head-on checks substantive neck base and body volume, not a flattened ribbon.
Perspective frames whole neck and all limbs; original extreme-neck gate must remain readable at512preview.
